---
title: "Grid, boundary, and parameter sensitivity"
description: "Compare surfaces across grid resolution, domain, and interpolation settings without treating spread as uncertainty."
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Use an explicit scenario table to vary resolution, padding, masks, smoothing,
neighbors, trends, or covariance controls. `ps_surface_sensitivity()` keeps
failed scenarios, identifies one reference, reports common support and support
area change separately, and makes the self-comparison exactly zero. It does not
select a preferred scenario automatically.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
scenarios <- expand.grid(grid_res=c(50,100), idw_power=c(1.5,2,3))
s <- ps_surface_sensitivity(points, "IDW", scenarios, reference=1)
```
